recipe.visualDefinition: A detailed, monochromatic ballpoint pen illustration of an acoustic guitar's soundhole and strings, featuring a label visible inside the body and a modern typographic overlay in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal strings intersecting the oval soundhole
Fine cross-hatched wood grain texture against dark soundhole void
Clean typographic blocks contrasting with hand-drawn organic lines
Single red color block breaking the grayscale palette
coreInvariants: Ballpoint pen texture with visible ink strokes
Diagonal composition of the guitar neck and strings
White and red rectangular text backgrounds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The guitar soundhole is the central focal point, slightly offset to the right, with strings running diagonally from top-left to bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavily shaded soundhole acts as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the diagonal strings down to the soundhole label, then jump to the high-contrast text blocks in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The light wood grain areas provide breathing room for the dense hatching of the guitar body.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and gray (paper and ink tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black (heavy pen shading in soundhole)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a single high-saturation red punch; value range is wide from white paper to black ink.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to monochrome plus one accent color

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast slab serif with irregular spacing
Secondary text uses a geometric sans-serif
Internal label text uses a fluid, decorative script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the primary title appear as if cut out and pasted
Lowercase sans-serif for the secondary line to create a modern contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Traditional serif paired with a modern lowercase sans-serif for a 'label-maker' or 'collage' aesthetic.

avoid: Script fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the typewriter/pasted-label feel of the main title
Provides the clean, geometric contrast for the red strip

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a detailed ballpoint pen sketch of an acoustic guitar soundhole. Use cross-hatching for the wood grain and deep, dark shading inside the hole. The perspective should be a close-up diagonal view showing the strings and the label inside the guitar body.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white rectangular strip in the upper right with a bold slab-serif title. Below it, add a red rectangular strip with a white lowercase sans-serif subtitle, slightly offset to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the wood grain texture achieved through pen-like hatching?
Does the red strip provide a sharp color contrast?
Are the strings rendered as distinct, fine lines?
Is the text contained within clean rectangular blocks?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific band name or logo
Ensure the label inside the guitar is generic or abstract
postGenerationChecks: Verify the ink texture looks like ballpoint pen, not charcoal or pencil.
Check that the red strip is a solid, flat color.
Ensure the diagonal composition is maintained.
Confirm the text is legible against its background strips.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ballpoint pen guitar sketch + diagonal composition + dual-color typographic label overlay.
